name: Amazon Subscribe & Save - Cancel All
description:
Take control of your Amazon Subscribe & Save subscriptions.

Keep the items you want, cancel the ones you don't, and manage subscriptions directly on Amazon.

FEATURES
• Cancel unkept subscriptions together from the floating panel or browser menu.
• Keep individual subscriptions with one click; your choices are remembered locally.
• Cancel a single subscription directly from its product card.
• See product names and pictures in the management panel.
• Get reminders on Amazon when a saved estimated delivery date is within seven days.
• Detect new Subscribe & Save subscriptions on supported confirmation pages.
• Automatically clear stale reminders when Amazon confirms there are no active subscriptions.

HOW TO USE
Sign in to Amazon, open your Subscribe & Save page, choose Keep for subscriptions you want to retain, then use the cancellation controls for the rest.

Works on Amazon.com, Amazon.ca, and Amazon.co.uk. An existing Amazon account is required. Reminder dates are estimates from Amazon, not guaranteed shipping deadlines. Cancelling a subscription does not necessarily cancel an order that has already been created or shipped. Amazon can require you to complete a cancellation on its own subscriptions page.

PRIVACY
Subscription details, Keep choices, and reminder preferences stay in your browser's local storage. The extension communicates directly with Amazon using your existing signed-in session. No developer servers, analytics, advertising, or sale of data.

Independent extension by Tyler Buza: https://buza.dev
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
singlePurpose: Help users manage their own Amazon Subscribe & Save subscriptions by choosing which to keep or cancel and seeing upcoming delivery reminders on supported Amazon sites.
storageJustification: Stores subscription IDs, product names and image URLs, estimated delivery dates, purchase IDs, Keep preferences, pending subscription detections, and reminder-dismissal timestamps locally in the browser. These support the subscription list, cancellation controls, and delivery reminders. No sync storage or developer server is used.
scriptingJustification: Injects the extension's packaged cancel.js and content.js into a supported Amazon subscription-management tab if the popup cannot reach the content script, such as after an extension reload. This restores the user-requested subscription-management controls. No remotely hosted code is executed.
hostJustification: Access is limited to https://www.amazon.com/*, https://www.amazon.ca/* and https://www.amazon.co.uk/*. It is needed to read subscription cards, fetch Amazon's subscription manager and cancellation forms, submit a cancellation selected by the user, detect Subscribe Now actions and confirmation pages, and display upcoming-delivery reminders while the user browses those Amazon sites. Requests use the user's existing Amazon session and go directly to Amazon.
testInstructions: No extension account, paid subscription, or developer-provided credentials are required. Sign in using an Amazon test account on amazon.com, amazon.ca, or amazon.co.uk. Open /auto-deliveries/viewsubscriptions to see Keep and Cancel controls for existing Subscribe & Save subscriptions and the floating management panel. Open the toolbar popup to view the same subscription list. Mark a subscription Keep and verify it is excluded from Cancel All. Cancellation changes the Amazon account; test it only with a test subscription you intend to cancel. With an estimated delivery date within seven days, visit another page on the same Amazon site to see the reminder. If Amazon reports No active subscriptions, stale saved reminders are removed. Pending new orders remain available for review. The extension does not provide or create Amazon accounts.
